title: UIL No Pass, No Play in Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
Activity types of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** whose academic rule is UIL no pass, no play apply the following; types whose academic rule is none never become ineligible.

1. **Becoming ineligible.** A student with a grade below 70 in any class at the end of a nine-week grading period becomes ineligible the type's grace days, in calendar days, after the grading period ends, and stays ineligible for at least the type's minimum number of school weeks.
2. **Regaining eligibility.** Eligibility is restored at the first progress check after that minimum at which every class grade is 70 or above, and the student returns to cleared without a new packet or new fees.
3. **While ineligible.** The student may practice but may not compete, perform or travel. No fee is credited for time spent ineligible, and a season that ends while the student is ineligible completes normally.

## Grade boundary

| Lowest class grade at the end of the grading period | Effect |
|---|---|
| 69 | ineligible after the grace days |
| 70 | no ineligibility from this grading period |

## Illustration (hypothetical calendar, grace of 7 days, minimum of 3 school weeks)

A grading period ends on a hypothetical day G with one class grade of 64. The student is ineligible from day G plus 7. The first progress check after the 3 school weeks at which every class grade is 70 or above restores eligibility; a check inside the 3 weeks does not, whatever the grades. Throughout, the student may practice, no part of the fees is credited, and if the season ends first, the participation completes.
